title: Accounting Assistant (m/f/d) – Credit Card Reconciliation Full-time or part-time, working students are also welcome
html:
What you do

  • Processing and reconciling credit card statements
  • Allocating and posting credit card transactions, e.g. fuel, handling, landing fees, catering, crew expenses and travel expenses
  • Obtaining and checking missing receipts from cardholders and relevant departments
  • Resolving discrepancies, disputes and chargebacks with card providers
  • For full-time positions: additional accounting duties, such as processing incoming and outgoing invoices, bank transactions and other general accounting tasks

Your profile

  • Commercial or business-related vocational training, an ongoing degree (e.g. Business Administration, Economics or a related field), or professional experience in accounting
  • Initial knowledge of accounting principles, including debits and credits and charts of accounts, is an advantage
  • Experience in credit card or travel expense reconciliation is desirable
  • Previous experience in the aviation industry is preferred, e.g. with an airline, airport, handling agent, charter operator, business aviation or flight support provider, as well as familiarity with industry-specific costs and terminology
  • Confident use of MS Office, particularly Excel
  • Experience with MOSS or similar credit card processing software is an advantage
  • Very good German and good English skills, for communication with international service providers and card holders
  • Careful, structured and reliable approach to work
  • Discretion when handling sensitive financial and credit card data

Why us?

  • Flexible working arrangements: full-time, part-time or as a working student (up to 20 hours per week)
  • Fair and competitive remuneration
  • Thorough training and onboarding in a friendly and supportive team
  • An exciting insight into the financial processes of the aviation industry
  • Opportunity for an extension or transition to a permanent position
  • Good transport links and the option to work from home
  • Additional benefits, including a contribution towards public transport costs, employee discounts, drinks and fresh fruit

title: B1/B2 Aircraft Technician (m/w/d)
html:
Your mission

As aB1/B2 Aircraft Technician at Platoon Aviation, you will play a key role in ensuring the continued airworthiness, reliability, and operational availability of our business jet fleet across Europe. With a strong focus onAircraft-on-Ground (AOG) support, you will respond to technical issues at aircraft locations, provide rapid and practical maintenance solutions, and help return aircraft to service safely and efficiently.

You will work hands-on in a dynamic, international environment, supporting scheduled and unscheduled maintenance activities while representing Platoon Aviation at airports, FBOs, hangars, and partner facilities throughout Europe.

  • Provide rapid, high-quality AOG maintenance support across Europe, responding to technical defects and operational disruptions at short notice.

  • Travel independently to aircraft locations across Europe to assess, troubleshoot, and rectify AOG events, ensuring a safe and efficient return to service whenever possible.

  • Perform line maintenance, troubleshooting, inspections, defect rectification, and component replacements in accordance with approved maintenance data, company procedures, and applicable aviation regulations.

  • Diagnose and rectify mechanical, electrical, and/or avionic defects within the scope of your licence, qualifications, aircraft type ratings, and company authorisations.

  • Carry out line checks, transit checks, servicing, minor repairs, and other maintenance activities required to support operational aircraft availability.

  • Work closely with Maintenance Control, CAMO, Flight Operations, aircraft crews, external maintenance organisations, suppliers, and airport partners to coordinate AOG recovery and maintenance activities.

  • Assess technical defects pragmatically and professionally, identify suitable rectification options, and communicate clear technical updates and realistic timelines to the relevant operational stakeholders.

  • Ensure that all maintenance activities, defect findings, component changes, and maintenance actions are documented accurately, completely, and on time in the relevant technical records and company systems.

  • Where authorised, issue Certificates of Release to Service (CRS) following completed maintenance work.

  • Maintain the highest standards of safety, compliance, quality, housekeeping, and professional conduct in every assignment.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of AOG response processes, maintenance procedures, technical reliability, and fleet availability.

Your profile

You are a reliable and solution-oriented aviation professional who enjoys working independently in an operational, international environment. You remain calm under pressure, take ownership of technical issues, and understand that safe and timely aircraft availability is essential to a premium business aviation operation.

  • Valid EASA Part-66 Aircraft Maintenance Licence, ideally B1.1, B2 or B1/B2.

  • At least five years of relevant professional experience in aircraft maintenance are required, preferably within business aviation and with exposure to line maintenance, mobile maintenance assignments and/or Europe-wide AOG support.

  • Current or previous type ratings on business jets are highly desirable; experience on the Platoon Aviation fleet or comparable aircraft types is an advantage.

  • Practical professional experience in aircraft line maintenance, base maintenance, or AOG support.

  • Strong troubleshooting skills in mechanical, electrical, and/or avionic aircraft systems.

  • Experience working in a Part-145 and/or continuing airworthiness environment is desirable.

  • A careful, structured, and safety-conscious way of working, with a strong understanding of technical documentation and regulatory compliance.

  • Ability to work independently, prioritise tasks effectively, and make sound decisions in time-sensitive operational situations.

  • Willingness and flexibility to travel frequently across Europe, including assignments at short notice and occasional work outside standard office hours.

  • Very good German and English language skills, both written and spoken.

  • Valid EU passport.

  • Valid driving licence, ideally Class B / Category B is mandatory.

  • Strong communication skills and a professional, service-oriented appearance when working with flight crews, airport partners, suppliers, and customers.


Why us?

At Platoon Aviation, you will become part of a fast-moving and international business aviation environment where technical expertise has a direct impact on our daily operation. Your work will not be limited to one fixed location: you will support our fleet where it is needed and play an essential role in ensuring that our aircraft remain safe, reliable, and ready to fly.

  • A varied and responsible role with direct operational relevance.

  • The opportunity to work with a modern business aviation fleet in an international environment.

  • A high degree of autonomy and trust in your technical expertise.

  • Diverse assignments across Europe instead of a purely hangar-based routine.

  • Close collaboration with experienced colleagues from Maintenance, CAMO, Flight Operations, and the wider Platoon Aviation team.

  • A dynamic company culture with short decision-making paths and room to contribute your own ideas.

  • Attractive development opportunities, including support for relevant aircraft type ratings, recurrent training, and technical qualifications.

  • A professional yet personal working environment in which reliability, teamwork, ownership, and a pragmatic hands-on mindset are valued.

Ready to keep our fleet moving across Europe? We look forward receiving your application.



Apply Now

title: Cabin Service Representative (m/f/d)
html:
Your mission

In this role, you will be the heart of the onboard experience in our Cessna Citation Longitude, ensuring that every journey reflects the highest standards of private aviation. You create more than just service - you shape an atmosphere of calm, refined luxury where discretion, anticipation of needs and genuine hospitality define every moment on board. Our passengers expect absolute excellence, you are the person who makes this standard feel effortless, personal and consistently exceptional.

To achieve this, you will take full responsibility for the cabin environment and the guest experience from take-off to landing:
  • Deliver a highly personalizes, discreet service tailored to individual passenger preferences
  • Ensure impeccable cabin preparation, presentations and continuous onboard comfort
  • Coordinate and serve premium catering in line with fine dining and executive aviation standards
  • Anticipate guest needs proactively, ensuring a seamless and uninterrupted experience
  • Maintain the highest safety standards and strictly follow all operational procedures
  • Carry out all post-flight duties, including cleaning, tidying and resetting the cabin, replenishing onboard stock items and completing accurate reporting to Headquarter where required
  • Represent the company with professionalism, elegance and absolute confidentially
  • Adapt flexibility to international, varying schedules and short-notice flights

Your profile

  • Strong background in luxury hospitality or fine dining service 
  • Proven experience as Cabin Crew in private aviation 
  • Excellent English communication skills; additional languages are a strong advantage
  • High degree of travel flexibility and willingness to be away from home for multiple consecutive days, including weekends and public holidays
  • Strong sense of cultural awareness, respect and adaptability when interacting with international guests
  • Confident working independently as the sole cabin presence, while ensuring close and professional coordination with the cockpit crew
  • Calm, composed and solution-oriented personality, even in high-pressure or challenging situations
  • Emotional intelligence is a key part of the job
  • Unrestricted EU-passport and right to work in the EU
  • Driving license
  • Minimum age: 21 years

Why us?

We offer a highly professional private aviation environment where excellence, discretion and consistency define everything we do. Operating the Cessna Citation Longitude, you will be part of an international operation that values reliability, respect and true service quality at the highest level of executive aviation. Our structure is designed to support both operational excellence and a sustainable work-life balance within a demanding but rewarding industry.

What we offer:
  • Start date: March 2027
  • Open base concept (Base in France not possible)
  • Summer: 10 Days Off/month guaranteed
  • Winter: 12 Days Off/month guaranteed
  • 100% roster stability
  • Fair senority-based salary

title: Flight Dispatcher (m/f/d)
html:
Your mission

We are a dynamic and growing General Aviation company committed to delivering safe, efficient, and high-quality aviation services. Our operations are built on strong safety standards, strict regulatory compliance, and a clear focus on operational excellence.

As part of our continued growth, we are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Flight Dispatcher to join our Operations team on-site in our Hamburg office and actively support the safe and efficient execution of our flights:

  • Prepare and file flight plans in compliance with regulatory and company requirements

  • Conduct weather analysis (METARs, TAFs, NOTAMs, winds aloft) and operational risk assessments

  • Calculate fuel requirements, payload limitations, alternates, and route optimization

  • Monitor active flights and provide real-time operational support to flight crews

  • Coordinate with ground handlers, FBOs, fuel providers, and aviation authorities

  • Liaise closely with the Commercial Department regarding scheduling, aircraft availability, and client operational requirements

  • Ensure compliance with aviation regulations, MEL/CDL limitations, and company SOPs

  • Maintain accurate operational records and reports

Your profile

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in aviation operations or flight dispatch

  • Solid understanding of flight planning, meteorology, and aviation regulations

  • Strong communication, coordination, and decision-making skills

  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment

  • Proficiency in operational systems

  • Flight Dispatcher License is an advantage but not mandatory

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken, is mandatory; German language skills are an advantage

  • Unrestricted right to work in the EU

Why us?

At Platoon Aviation, you will join a stable and steadily growing Business Aviation company that combines operational excellence with a strong safety culture. We offer a competitive salary and an attractive benefits package that reflects the responsibility and expertise required in this role.

You will work in a professional and growth-oriented aviation environment where teamwork, precision, and reliability are valued every day. At the same time, we actively support your professional development and provide opportunities to expand your knowledge and advance your career within our organization.

title: Junior Sales Manager (m/f/d) - Hamburg
html:
Your mission

You thrive in fast-paced environments, love closing deals and want to be part of the european private aviation market? Then this role might be for you:
  • Turn requests into flights. You evaluate incoming charter requests, check aircraft availability and operational feasibility, and prepare competitive charter quotes for the international broker market.
  • Close deals. You negotiate charter prices with brokers, understand their clients' needs and guide requests from the first inquiry all the way to a confirmed flight.
  • Own the flight coordination. Once a deal is closed, you ensure flawless execution by coordinating with internal teams such as crew planning and flight dispatch as well as external partners like handling agents and catering providers.
  • Keep everyone informed. You communicate updates such as schedule changes, weather impacts or delays proactively to brokers and partners.
  • Monitor flights in real time. You keep an eye on active operations, anticipate potential issues and help resolve them quickly to guarantee a smooth client experience.
  • Build strong relationships. You develop long-term partnerships with charter brokers and operators and become a trusted contact in the network.

Your profile

  • You have first experience in sales, negotiation or customer-facing roles - experience in Aviation, travel or luxury hospitality is a plus.
  • You are a strong communicator who enjoys building relationships with clients and partners.
  • You work structured and solution-oriented, even in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change quickly.
  • You are highly motivated, proactive and eager to take ownership
  • You are target-driven and motivated by closing deals and achieving results.
  • Your English is fluent (written and spoken) - our team, clients and partners are international.
  • You enjoy working in a dynamic 24/7 industry and are willing to work shifts and weekends when required.
  • You bring a professional attitude and strong interpersonal skills when working with colleagues, brokers and partners from different cultures.
  • You are able and willing to work to work on-site at our Hamburg headquarters.

Why us?

At Platoon Aviation, you will join a young and fast-growing company in the European private aviation market. Based in Hamburg, we operate a modern fleet and work with charter brokers and partners around the world to deliver exceptional charter experiences. As part of our team, you will be at the center of a dynamic and international industry where every day brings new destinations, new clients and new challenges.
 
Working with us means taking ownership from day one. In a growing organization like ours, your ideas and initiative matter. You will be trusted with real responsibility early on and have the opportunity to actively contribute to deals, operations and the overall success of the company.
 
Private aviation is fast-paced and exciting – and that is exactly what makes it so rewarding. You will work alongside experienced aviation professionals who share a passion for delivering outstanding service and making things happen, even when plans change at short notice.
 
As we continue to grow and expand our operations, we want our people to grow with us. If you are looking for a role where you can combine sales, aviation and international business while building your career in a dynamic environment, Platoon Aviation could be the perfect place for you.
Apply Now

If you are looking for a position where your experience, reputation and commercial drive are valued — and where you can actively shape growth rather than just manage accounts — Platoon Aviation offers the platform to do so.
